summary: Marginal boating day. Winds 5–10 kt, light chop on the bay. Numerous storms likely, mostly afternoon and evening, with gusty downpours that can spike local seas and gusts fast. Rain around 69%. Run the pass and any Gulf legs early.
gulf_seas: Around 2 feet this morning, then 1 foot or less
source: NWS Tampa Bay, Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFTBW)
